implementationStateAtFreeze: Design and immutable configuration only; no S08 runtime controller, fixture, injury-panel, stability-panel, inference, or replay trajectory existed.
frozenQuestion: Do prespecified failure-triggered reversible or irreversible changes in Algotype, sensing radius, local target selection, or exploration improve completion beyond an outcome-blind recovery-time/information/opportunity/cost-matched nonplastic controller, and what intact-pattern instability or efficiency harms do they cause?
s07Handoff: S07 found no completion advantage for any bounded local-memory variant versus recovery-time/opportunity/energy-matched controls. S08 therefore fixes the same case-specific recovery schedule in active, sham, and reference arms and treats active-versus-matched-sham behavior as primary; recovery-only or permanent-freeze comparisons cannot support a plasticity claim.

inherits.stabilityProbeBudget: 20*n charged opportunities from the exact stabilized post-completion checkpoint, with completion deliberately non-absorbing only inside this safety probe
inherits.checkpointState: occupancy, Selection cursors, activation count/global event clock, native stream counters, native ledger, and fresh S08 failure/plasticity state
inherits.target: unchanged direction-aware strict unequal inversion distance

failureTrigger.state: a saturating 2-bit counter 0..3 for every immutable actor identity
failureTrigger.update: after each own charged opportunity before any transition, reset to zero only after that actor's accepted Swap or MemoryUpdate; otherwise increment with saturation at three
failureTrigger.readyRule: at the start of a later own opportunity the prior counter equals three
failureTrigger.ordering: the current opportunity cannot make itself ready; the first serial ready actor consumes the one collective transition cycle and all other actors remain native
failureTrigger.locality: the state sees only actor identity and whether that actor's own final proposal changed state; it receives no selected-fault bit, occupancy, target, distance, progress, timing label, global event clock, other actor state, ledger total, future draw, or outcome
failureTrigger.rationale: the same injury-agnostic local rule can trigger during damaged recovery or intact stabilized behavior, making both benefit and false-activation harm observable

durability.reversible: transition suppresses one native proposal; the new mode governs exactly eight subsequent charged opportunities of the triggering actor; reversion suppresses that actor's next native proposal, costs one action/energy unit, restores the original mode for the following opportunity, and cannot retrigger
durability.irreversible: transition suppresses one native proposal and the new mode persists until terminal or phase-budget censoring; it cannot retrigger
durability.transitionBoundary: the mode becomes active only after the transition opportunity and is therefore usable on the triggering actor's next opportunity
durability.reversionBoundary: reversion becomes effective after its suppressing opportunity
durability.cycleBudget: one collective transition cycle per run; reversible cycles contain one activation and one reversion, irreversible cycles one activation

mechanisms.activeRule: switch only the triggering actor's proposal Algotype by the frozen mapping Bubble to Insertion, Insertion to Bubble, Selection to Bubble; the alternate Algotype uses its ordinary native information rule, with deterministic left/right alternation from the actor-local mode counter when a newly selected Bubble side is required
mechanisms.targetPermission: the immutable actor direction and unchanged target order only; no target identity, global target state, progress, or completion signal
mechanisms.sensingPermission: the declared alternate native Algotype capability; any broader prefix exposure is explicitly metered and exposed identically to sham

mechanisms.activeRule: expand only the triggering actor's geometric observation from its native decision surface to the bounded positions at offsets -2,-1,+1,+2; if a strict two-hop directional violation exists, propose one adjacent step toward the lexically first left-then-right violation, otherwise NoOp
mechanisms.targetPermission: the actor's immutable direction plus values/fault modes within radius two; no target identity, global occupancy, distance, progress, or completion

mechanisms.activeRule: choose exactly one bounded adjacent alternative without constructing a native candidate: Bubble uses the side opposite its already scheduled side; Insertion uses right instead of its native left; Selection uses the adjacent side opposite the current cursor direction; swap only for a strict directional inversion, otherwise NoOp
mechanisms.targetPermission: one actor record, its own Bubble side or Selection cursor where native, and one adjacent value/fault record; no nonlocal identity or target score

mechanisms.activeRule: alternate left/right using the triggering actor's bounded mode-opportunity parity and propose one mechanically legal adjacent Swap regardless of value ordering; boundary or non-normal neighbor yields NoOp
mechanisms.targetPermission: no target value comparison and no task-score input; exploration can therefore improve or damage the unchanged target
mechanisms.sensingPermission: one adjacent position/fault record at radius one

componentAblation: The eight active variants are prespecified one-component interventions: each isolates one of four behavior components at each of two durability levels on the same paired panel. No learned or outcome-selected union is fit.

controls.semantics: run the identical local trigger, transition/reversion state machine, information exposure, fixed sensing/compute charges, native-opportunity suppression, and action/energy costs, but retain the actor's native proposal rule throughout

use the same prior-S07 recovery schedule and its one suppressed proposal/action/energy cost, but instantiate no S08 trigger, mode, added sensing, transition, or reversion; descriptive opportunity-cost reference only

recoveryScheduleControl.assignment: exact same-case duration indexed only by S01 pairing block and S02 timing condition; all 384 donors recovered in S07
recoveryScheduleControl.outcomeBlindness: S07 was complete before S08 was specified; no S08 outcome can enter the schedule
recoveryScheduleControl.runtimeSemantics: at the assigned duration, suppress one native proposal, spend one action and one abstract energy unit, then unfreeze the selected identity for the next charged opportunity
recoveryScheduleControl.collisionPrecedence: a scheduled recovery event has priority over an otherwise-ready S08 transition on the same opportunity; the prior trigger state remains available for a later opportunity
recoveryScheduleControl.claimBoundary: active-versus-sham is primary because both receive identical recovery scheduling; reference contrasts cannot establish plasticity

costs.recovery: one suppressed native proposal, one action unit, and one abstract energy unit in every injury arm
costs.transition: one suppressed native proposal, one action unit, and one abstract energy unit
costs.reversion: one suppressed native proposal, one action unit, and one abstract energy unit for reversible variants only
costs.modeOpportunity: one final proposal only; charge one abstract compute-energy unit plus the mechanism's declared adaptive sensing reads and sensing-energy units in both active and matched-sham arms
costs.sensing: meter every adaptive actor/neighbor/prefix record exposed to the plastic or sham gateway; radius expansion is capped at four non-self positions
costs.storage: two failure-counter bits per identity plus mode-active/ever-transitioned bits, a triggering-identity tag of ceil(log2(n)) bits, a four-bit reversible duration counter when applicable, and the declared mechanism tag/parity bits
costs.energyInterpretation: all energy is an abstract transparent accounting unit without physical or biological units

pairingAndStreams.root: retain the original executable S01 scenario ID and exact S02/S03 checkpoint/anchor state
pairingAndStreams.activeShamPrefix: exact through the transition opportunity because trigger state and proposals are identical; after behavior changes, base counter-addressed marginals remain scenario-rooted and coupling is claimed only where address and consumption remain equal
pairingAndStreams.modeSideChoice: bounded actor-local mode-opportunity parity; no new RNG stream
pairingAndStreams.prohibitions: no dummy runtime draw, global-progress read, outcome-conditioned transition, replacement actor, retry, second final proposal, or scenario reconstruction

intactStability.source: all 48 exact S02 stabilized post_completion checkpoints before the S03 lesion anchor
intactStability.probe: resume exact native state and run exactly 20*n charged uniform opportunities even though occupancy starts complete; this non-absorbing extension is used only to measure whether a false local-failure trigger destabilizes the already certified target
intactStability.arms: active and matched sham for every variant plus one shared native nonplastic reference
outcomes: action, energy, sensing, and suppressed-opportunity costs
intactStability.claimBoundary: the stability probe is an engineered safety test, not a new development or recovery task and not biological homeostasis

successCriteria.primaryRecoveryEndpoint: final-target completion in confirmatory replicates 2-3, retaining every quiescent, event-budget, transition-censored, reversion-censored, and recovery-censored case
successCriteria.primaryRecoveryContrasts: each of eight active variants versus its exact matched_nonplastic_sham on the injury panel
successCriteria.primaryStabilityEndpoint: any target departure during the 20*n intact probe across all 48 post-completion blocks
successCriteria.primaryStabilityContrasts: each active variant versus its matched_nonplastic_sham
successCriteria.test: two-sided exact McNemar tests on paired binary outcomes
successCriteria.multiplicity: Holm correction separately across eight recovery contrasts and eight stability-harm contrasts at family-wise alpha 0.05
successCriteria.uncertainty: paired risk-difference 95% t intervals plus complete paired continuous trade-off summaries; no recovered-only, completed-only, transitioned-only, or outcome-selected cohort
successCriteria.supportive: all validation gates pass and at least one variant has a positive Holm-significant recovery-completion difference with no Holm-significant stability harm for that variant
successCriteria.null: all validation gates pass and no variant has Holm-significant recovery benefit, recovery harm, or intact-stability harm
successCriteria.constrainingContradictory: a validation/identifiability gate fails, any variant has Holm-significant recovery harm, or any variant has Holm-significant intact-stability harm

claimBoundary: S08 tests hand-designed failure-triggered controller changes inside a transparent simulator. Plasticity, adaptation, sensing expansion, exploration, action costs, energy, recovery, and stability are engineered computational constructs, not evolved behavior, biological plasticity, physical energy, wet-lab evidence, or a claim outside the frozen panel.
